title: 第14章 是纯阴女
novel_title: 觉醒阴阳神功：分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
这名被称作“梅姐”的女人，缓缓从沙发上坐了起来，整理了一下身上的吊带裙，抬眸看向陈阳，眼神复杂，带着几分审视和探究。

    满脸胡子的龙坤语气恭敬说：“梅姐，就是这小子，刚刚在赌场里赢了我们足足200多万，手法怪异，不像是普通赌徒。”

    说着，他将手上刚从陈阳那车上提下的钱袋，放在一边。

    两名西装男立刻上前，半架半扶着陈阳，径直将他带到柳醉梅身前，然后恭敬地退到一旁。

    柳醉梅微微抬眸，目光落在陈阳身上，眼神依旧带着审视，语气平淡问：“你是新来的？以前没在我这里见过你。”

    陈阳的目光一直落在柳醉梅身上，脑海里反复回响着“纯阴体”三个字，心里抑制不住地激动。

    他怎么也没有想到，竟然会在这里遇到梦寐以求的纯阴女。

    若是能与她阴阳融合，自己就能激活新的神通。

    一想到这里，他眼底闪过一丝不易察觉的兴奋。

    他定了定神，语气恭敬地回应：“梅姐，我第一次来这里玩，以前从没来过。”

    柳醉梅身体微微前倾，眼神里的探究更甚，追问：“你叫什么名字？是做什么的？听我手下说，你一个小时不到就赢了我们200多万，你到底是怎么做到的？”

    陈阳抬眸，目光扫过大厅里的西装女和龙坤等人，又落回柳醉梅脸上，语气含糊：“梅姐，我叫陈阳。

    这里人太多，有些事情，我不太方便说。”

    他故意卖关子，一来是不想暴露透视眼的秘密，二来也想试探一下柳醉梅的态度。

    柳醉梅何等聪慧，瞬间明白了他的意思，当即向龙坤使了个眼色。

    龙坤心领神会，连忙带着身后的两名西装男，还有两侧的四名西装女，悄无声息地退出了大厅，轻轻带上了房门。

    瞬间，整个豪华大厅里只剩下陈阳、柳醉梅，还有柳醉梅身边站着的女手下桃夭。

    桃夭依旧面色清冷，眼神锐利地盯着陈阳，周身散发着强大的气场，一副随时准备出手的模样。
content_en:
The woman known as "Sister Mei" slowly sat up from the sofa, adjusted her suspender skirt, and raised her eyes to look at Chen Yang with complex eyes, a bit of scrutiny and exploration.

The bearded Long Kun said in a respectful tone: "Sister Mei, this is the guy who just won over 2 million from us in the casino. His technique was weird and he doesn't look like an ordinary gambler."

As he spoke, he put the money bag he had just taken off Chen Yang's car aside.

Two men in suits immediately stepped forward, half-supporting and half-supporting Chen Yang, and brought him directly to Liu Zuimei, then stepped aside respectfully.

Liu Zuimei raised her eyes slightly, and her eyes fell on Chen Yang. Her eyes were still scrutinizing, and she asked in a calm tone: "Are you new here? I have never seen you here before."

Chen Yang's eyes kept falling on Liu Zuimei, and the words "pure yin body" echoed repeatedly in his mind, and he couldn't help but feel excited.

He never imagined that he would meet the pure yin girl of his dreams here.

If he could merge with her yin and yang, he could activate new magical powers.

When he thought of this, a trace of imperceptible excitement flashed in his eyes.

He composed himself and responded in a respectful tone: "Sister Mei, this is my first time coming here to play. I have never been here before."

Liu Zuimei leaned forward slightly, her eyes even more probing, and asked: "What is your name? What do you do? I heard from my subordinates that you won us more than 2 million in less than an hour. How did you do it?"

Chen Yang raised his eyes, glanced at the woman in suit, Long Kun and others in the hall, and then returned to Liu Zuimei's face, with a vague tone: "Sister Mei, my name is Chen Yang.

There are too many people here, so there are some things that I can’t say."

He deliberately kept it secret, firstly because he didn't want to expose the secret of the clairvoyance, and secondly, he wanted to test Liu Zuimei's attitude.

Liu Zuimei was so smart that she instantly understood what he meant and winked at Long Kun.

Long Kun understood, and quickly left the hall quietly with the two men in suits behind him and the four women in suits on both sides, and gently closed the door.

In an instant, only Chen Yang, Liu Zuimei, and Tao Yao, the female subordinate standing next to Liu Zuimei, were left in the entire luxurious hall.

Tao Yao still had a cold face and stared at Chen Yang sharply. She exuded a strong aura and looked like she was ready to take action at any time.
title_en: Chapter 14 She is a pure yin girl
